name: hate
description: A strong desire to never experience a particular person, animal, thing, idea, or sensation ever again.

commentaries.quote: 'Hate' is a broad term that superficially applies to everything from your enemy to your least favorite food. Some people abuse the term

In all relationships involving other people, there's a pattern of signaling that reveals interest or disinterest. These signals can be obvious or subtle, immediate or slow, conscious or unconscious. These signals can sew us closer together bit by bit or drag us apart.
